Freezing Knights is a light co-op turn-based RPG for the PICO-8. It is a multi-cart game split over 14 cartridges and was mainly inspired by that one RPG series with two plumbers.

Take control of two knights and try to reach the end of the perilous snowy mountain paths​ by avoiding enemy attacks and powering-up your characters.

452537.overview:
A PICO-8 demake of FEZ. 
CONTROLS 
Left/Right: Walk
Up: Jump
Down: Drop/Interact
Z/X: Rotate the world

This is a tiny adventure based directly on FEZ, a game by the Polytron Corporation. It is a fan work, and was not made in collaboration with or endorsed by them.

FUZ features a total of 8 distinct areas. Its visuals, mechanics, and puzzles are all based off those in the original.

I made the music myself, as while FEZ has a phenomenal soundtrack a lot of it does not translate well to PICO-8. I can't claim to be very musically inclined, but I hope it works well enough.

Also, while there is no save system, the game is completable very quickly if you know what to do so getting back to your previous place is not hard.

453277.overview:
It's flood season, dig caves to redirect an inevitable rising water until you can save everyone.

This game was made in 48 hours for Ludum Dare 50 game jam .

Your digging power is limited, but it recharges over time. At regular intervals, you can save someone by sending your rescue team.

You can play the game using a keyboard (action is key C ), a gamepad, or a mouse.
